The complaint contains accusations only; Ross is presumed innocent.

events.summary: Elizabeth Oyer filed a federal complaint naming Blanche in his official capacity and the Department of Justice, alleging that Blanche removed her as a career Pardon Attorney after she refused pressure to recommend restoring firearm rights to actor Mel Gibson, a Trump acquaintance. The complaint alleges due-process, Civil Service Reform Act, and First Amendment violations, including removal based in part on perceived political affiliation; the claims remain unadjudicated.
